label: aqa-seed
target: Restful-Booker Platform, run locally with Docker (guest site and /admin - verify ports)
note: Evaluation backlog for attestqa v1.0.0 (research/EVALUATION_PLAN.md section 4). Run the stories in 'order'. 'kind', 'order', 'uiChange' and 'verify' are not posted to Azure DevOps.
verify: Repository and docker-compose of the current Restful-Booker Platform, the guest and admin URLs, and the ports; record in TestRunApplication/targets.yaml.
Admin account (expected: admin / password). Put it in .env as AQA_APP_USER/AQA_APP_PASS, never in this file.
How to reset the app to its seed data between runs (restart the containers, or the reset the platform provides).
Reproduce both linked bugs on the build under test before seeding. A bug that does not reproduce is filed as Resolved, or replaced by one that does in the same area.

description: What a visitor sees and does on the B&B's public site before booking.
Target: Restful-Booker Platform running locally. Test data only.
Choosing dates and giving guest details to book a room.
What the owner does in the admin area: rooms, messages, branding and the bookings report.

stories.summary: Visitor sees the B&B and its rooms on the home page
description: As a visitor I want to see what the B&B is and which rooms it offers, so that I can decide whether to stay.
acceptance: AC-1: The home page shows the B&B's name and description.
AC-2: The home page lists the rooms, each with its type, a picture and a way to book it.
AC-3: The home page shows the B&B's contact details: address, phone and email.

stories.summary: Visitor is told what is wrong with the contact form
description: As a visitor I want to know what to fix when my message cannot be sent.
acceptance: AC-1: Submitting the contact form with every field empty shows a message for each required field, and nothing is sent.
AC-2: A phone number shorter than the allowed length is refused with a message giving the allowed length.
AC-3: A message shorter than the allowed length is refused with a message giving the allowed length.
verify: The allowed lengths for phone, subject and message, so test data can be chosen around them.

stories.summary: Visitor's message reaches the owner, and only the owner
description: As the owner I want visitors' messages to reach my admin inbox, and nobody else to be able to read them.
acceptance: AC-1: After a visitor sends a valid message, the site thanks the visitor by name.
AC-2: The message then appears in the admin messages list with the visitor's name and subject.
AC-3: A visitor who is not signed in and opens the admin messages address does not see any messages.

stories.summary: Guest chooses dates for a room
description: As a guest I want to pick the nights I want to stay so that I can book a room.
acceptance: AC-1: Choosing to book a room shows a calendar for that room.
AC-2: Selecting a check-in and a check-out date shows the chosen nights in the calendar and the price for the stay.
AC-3: Dates that are already booked are shown as unavailable.
verify: How the current guest site shows the price and unavailable nights (calendar vs. summary).

stories.summary: Guest gives their details to complete a booking
description: As a guest I want to give my name and contact details so that the booking is in my name.
acceptance: AC-1: With dates chosen, filling in first name, last name, email and phone and booking shows a booking confirmation with the dates.
AC-2: Booking with a required detail left empty shows a message for that field, and no booking is made.
AC-3: An email address without an @ is refused with a message about the email format.

stories.summary: Owner signs in to and out of the admin area
description: As the owner I want to sign in to the admin area, and to sign out when I am done.
acceptance: AC-1: Signing in with the admin username and password shows the admin area with its menu.
AC-2: A wrong password shows an error and the admin area is not shown.
AC-3: Choosing Logout signs the owner out and shows the sign-in form again.

description: As the owner I want to add a room so that guests can book it.
acceptance: AC-1: Creating a room with a room number, a type, accessibility, a price and some features adds it to the room list with those values.
AC-2: Creating a room without a room number or without a price is refused with a message, and no room is added.
AC-3: A newly created room appears on the guest home page.

stories.summary: Owner edits and deletes a room
description: As the owner I want to correct a room's details, or remove a room I no longer let.
acceptance: AC-1: Editing a room's price and saving shows the new price in the room's details and in the room list.
AC-2: Deleting a room removes it from the room list.
AC-3: A deleted room no longer appears on the guest home page.
stories.uiChange: After the first run: rename the edit button's visible text and change the room list from a table to cards. Run the story again against that build.

stories.summary: Owner reads messages and they are marked as read
description: As the owner I want to read visitors' messages and see which ones are new.
acceptance: AC-1: The messages list shows each message's sender and subject, with unread messages marked.
AC-2: Opening a message shows its full text and contact details, and the message is then shown as read.
AC-3: The messages page passes an automated WCAG 2.1 A/AA accessibility scan.

description: As the owner I want to change the B&B's name and description so that the site shows the right details.
acceptance: AC-1: Changing the B&B name and description in Branding and submitting shows a confirmation.
AC-2: The guest home page then shows the new name and description.
AC-3: Submitting Branding with the name empty is refused with a message, and the guest site keeps the old name.
comments: Product owner: the tests must put the original branding back when they finish, because every other story's home page checks depend on it.
stories.uiChange: After the first run: rename the Branding menu entry and the submit button's text. Run the story again against that build.

stories.summary: Owner sees bookings in the report calendar
description: As the owner I want to see which rooms are booked on which nights.
acceptance: AC-1: The report shows a calendar with each booking as an entry on its nights.
AC-2: A booking made on the guest site appears in the report on its nights, with the guest's name.
AC-3: Moving to the next month shows that month's bookings.

stories.summary: A room cannot be booked twice for the same night
description: As the owner I want a room never to be booked twice for the same night.
acceptance: AC-1: Trying to book a room for nights that are already booked is refused with a message saying the dates are not available.
AC-2: After the refusal the room's existing booking is unchanged in the report.
AC-3: Booking the same room for free nights straight after the existing booking succeeds.

bugs.summary: Report does not show bookings made on the guest site until the page is reloaded
description: Steps: open the admin report, make a booking on the guest site in another tab, return to the report.
EXPECTED: the new booking appears on its nights.
ACTUAL: it appears only after a full reload (to be confirmed on the build under test before seeding).
Filed by a person, not by attestqa.

bugs.summary: Overlapping booking that starts on another booking's last night is accepted
description: Steps: book a room for three nights; then book the same room starting on the last of those nights.
EXPECTED: refused, because that night is taken.
ACTUAL: the second booking is accepted (to be confirmed on the build under test before seeding).
Filed by a person, not by attestqa.
